ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity cream/white pixels localized at the lateral tips to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels dominating the central and lower regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white-to-cream regions situated on the distal ends of both lobes. These regions transition into a high-density black central field with significant gray-scale mottling and micro-spotting throughout the lower-central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex and high-depth ratio; approximate interior pixel-angle of 30 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The right lobe (viewer perspective) contains a distinct, large-scale jagged excision (semi-circular notch) on the upper edge. Left lobe exhibits smaller, more uniform sawtooth peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to the central notch; outer edges exhibit a slight convex curvature tapering to sharp lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle attachments) concentrated heavily at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse white circular focal spots visible within the black central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, dark diagonal linear disruption (rake mark) extending from the lower-left lobe center towards the left tip. Multiple fine, shorter vertical linear scratches visible on the right white lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy peripheral barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow-brown pixel staining (bio-film or pigmentation variation) present within the high-intensity white regions of both fluke lobes.
